svg.title: Inside a Project
svg.desc: A Project stacks three layers: instructions that set behaviour for every chat, knowledge files that every chat can use, and the chats themselves, which share the knowledge but not each other's conversation.
svg.text: Chats share the knowledge and instructions, not each other's conversation.
Role, tone, format, rules: every chat
Files every chat can use; RAG on paid plans when it grows
